part_number.product: SEL-734B Advanced Monitoring and Control System (Revenue Meter)
part_number.note: 21-character Model Option Table from the SEL-734B 'No Enclosure' ordering information (WI-11892). Column positions were calibrated against the MOT box grid and the doc's own prefilled template string '0 7 3 4 0 F A' (which fixes positions 1-4, 6, 8, and 21). No customer part number or drawing-layer anchor was available, so positions are ordering-doc-derived only. Positions 6, 8, 17, and 21 are fixed template digits for this configuration. Positions 11 (metering voltage) and 12 (current class) are interdependent for the low-energy analog input options; position 18 (Expansion Slot 2) and 19 (its control-input voltage) are likewise paired. This is the No-Enclosure base-unit MOT; enclosure versions carry additional catalog part numbers not covered here.
references: SEL-734B Data Sheet (734B_DS_20251016) — no ordering MOT figure

options.0: SEL-734, Standard Power Quality, 32 MB Memory
options.P: SEL-734P, Advanced Power Quality, 128 MB Memory

positions.label: Fixed digit
positions.note: Fixed template digit for the SEL-734B No Enclosure configuration (prefilled '0' in the ordering-doc part-number template).

positions.label: Fixed digit
positions.note: Fixed template digit for the SEL-734B No Enclosure configuration (prefilled 'F' in the ordering-doc part-number template).

positions.label: Power Supply
positions.note: Field upgrade available. Each option includes 3 contact outputs and 2 inputs.

options.1: 125/250 Vdc or Vac; 3 Contact Outputs, 2 Inputs

positions.label: Metering Voltage
positions.note: Factory upgrade available. Interacts with the Current Class digit (position 12) for low-energy analog options: '3' pairs with current-class '6' (25 Vac LEA), and '1' pairs with current-class '5'/'6' (10 Vac LEA).

options.1: 57-120 Vin (also used with current-class 5/6 for 10 Vac Low-Energy Analog Inputs)
options.3: 25 Vac Low-Energy Analog Inputs (with current-class digit 6)

positions.label: Current Class
positions.note: Interacts with the Metering Voltage digit (position 11). Codes 1/2/3 are standard current classes; 5 and 6 select low-energy analog inputs in combination with position 11.

options.5: 10 Vac LEA IA, IB, IC (with metering-voltage digit 1)
options.6: 25 Vac Low-Energy (metering 3) / 10 Vac LEA IA, IB, IC, IN (metering 1)

options.E: Two EIA-232 Ports and One 10/100BASE-T Ethernet Port
options.F: One EIA-232 Port and One EIA-485 Port
options.G: One EIA-232 Port, One EIA-485 Port, and One 10/100BASE-T Ethernet Port
options.H: Two EIA-232 Ports and One 100BASE-FX Fiber-Optic Ethernet Port
options.J: One EIA-232 Port, One EIA-485 Port, and One 100BASE-FX Fiber-Optic Ethernet Port

positions.label: Expansion Slot 1
positions.note: Field upgrade available. Expansion Slot 1 communication ports can only be used one at a time. First digit of the two-character Expansion Slot 1 code; the second digit (position 17) is always 'X'.

options.5: Telephone Modem plus Additional EIA-232 and EIA-485 Port

positions.label: Expansion Slot 1 (second digit)
positions.note: Fixed second character of the Expansion Slot 1 code; always 'X' in the ordering doc.

options.X: Fixed (second character of Expansion Slot 1 code)

positions.label: Expansion Slot 2
positions.note: Field upgrade available. Options with digital inputs set the control-input voltage at position 19; analog-output and empty options leave position 19 = 'X'.

options.A: 2 Electromechanical 30 Amp Contact Outputs, 4 Digital Inputs

positions.label: Control Input Voltage for Expansion Slot 2
positions.note: Field upgrade available. 'X' when the Expansion Slot 2 option has no digital inputs.

options.2: SEL ASCII, SEL Distributed Port Switch Protocol, SEL Fast Meter, Synchrophasors, SEL Compressed ASCII, MV-90 Translation, Modbus RTU/TCP, Mirrored Bits Communications, and Telnet
options.3: DNP3 Level 2 Slave Serial and LAN/WAN (includes all protocols listed above)
